# openobserve_service_accounts (Data Source)

Lists the service accounts of an OpenObserve organization. API tokens are never returned by this endpoint, so none appear here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openobserve_service_accounts" "all" {}

output "service_account_emails" {
  value = [for a in data.openobserve_service_accounts.all.service_accounts : a.email]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source ID.
- `service_accounts` (Attributes List) The service accounts found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_accounts))

<a id="nestedatt--service_accounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service_accounts`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (Number) Creation timestamp in microseconds.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `first_name` (String) Given name.
- `is_external` (Boolean) True when the account comes from an external identity provider.
- `last_name` (String) Family name.
- `role` (String) Built-in organization role.
